metadata.schedule_summary: Induction lasts four planned 21-day cycles unless treatment needs to stop earlier. On Day 1 you receive serplulimab, carboplatin and etoposide by drip. With the standard IV schedule, etoposide is repeated on Days 2 and 3. After induction, carboplatin and etoposide stop. Serplulimab alone can continue every three weeks while it is helping and its risks remain acceptable. There is no fixed universal number of maintenance cycles in this NCCP regimen. Your team may instead prescribe etoposide by drip on Day 1 and capsules twice daily on Days 2 and 3. This is a separate alternative, not extra treatment. Oral and IV doses are not interchangeable milligram for milligram. Confirm which plan you have; take the capsules on an empty stomach as prescribed.

treatment.schedule_summary: Induction: serplulimab 4.5 mg/kg and carboplatin AUC5 Day 1, etoposide 100 mg/m² IV Days 1–3, every 21 days for four cycles unless progression/toxicity. Then serplulimab alone every 21 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Explicit alternative: etoposide 100 mg/m² IV Day 1 and 100 mg/m² orally twice daily Days 2–3.
